title: Interactive 3D Retro-Tech Landing Page
overview: A high-end, interactive landing page featuring a 3D wireframe model of a 1980s-style desktop computer (CRT monitor, keyboard, and tower) centered in the viewport. The experience utilizes a 'Cyber-Grid' aesthetic with neon cyan highlights, a glitch effect, and a retro-tech atmosphere including a CRT scanline overlay.

userStories.want: To experience an immersive, retro-futuristic 3D environment
userStories.soThat: They are engaged by a visually striking and high-quality aesthetic.
The component can be easily integrated into the existing system without placeholder logic.

functionalRequirements: Render a 3D wireframe model of a 1980s-style desktop (CRT, keyboard, tower) using Three.js or a high-performance WebGL library.
Implement continuous, steady rotation of the 3D model on its Y-axis.
Apply 'Cyber-Grid' styling: neon cyan lines, glowing vertices, and a subtle 'glitch' effect.
Implement a deep charcoal gradient background with a CRT scanline overlay.
Create a glassmorphic navigation bar at the top of the viewport.
Create a 'System Status' info-panel in the bottom corner.
Ensure the 3D scene initializes automatically on load without placeholders.
nonFunctionalRequirements: High-performance WebGL rendering to ensure smooth 3D animation.
Fully responsive UI/UX across all device types.
Modularized code structure for production-ready deployment.
Optimized asset loading for 3D models and textures.
acceptanceCriteria: 3D model renders automatically on page load.
3D model rotates continuously on the Y-axis without stuttering.
Visual effects (neon, glow, glitch, scanlines) are clearly visible and consistent.
Navigation bar follows glassmorphic design principles.
System Status panel is correctly positioned in the bottom corner.
Page layout remains responsive and functional across different screen resolutions.
